Definition: Ramoth-Gilad, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Ramoth = "heights"; n pr m; 1) an Israelite who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; n pr loc; 2) Ramoth-gilead-a place in Gilead; 2a) site dubious
